constraint: Type 1 and turn intensity <= 2 apply to the two VTG teaching cards; LOOP slots are published Level-1 sequences. Every card starts and ends in Alpha, Beta, or Gamma. Rotated 16-step cards are Quartered; rotated 8-step cards are Halved.
selectionReason: Candidate 1 keeps Austen's approved LOOP control and pairs a no-turn same-direction TnD card with a one-turn opposite-direction TnD card. The print batch rotates through 90 distinct TnD pairs before repeating a pair.
